title: NanoFile MCP Tools Specification
description: Complete Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool declarations for NanoFile Desktop

tools.name: search_items
tools.description: Unified lightning search across both files and folders with selectable scope and speed modes.

query.description: Keyword, filename, or pattern to search

directory.description: Target root folder when scope is directory

tools.name: operate_item
tools.description: Perform single file or folder operation (copy, move, rename, delete).

source.description: Target file or folder absolute path

destination.description: Destination folder or new path (for copy/move)

tools.name: batch_operate_items
tools.description: Batch operation on multiple files or folders.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Search specifically for files with extension filter.

extension.description: Optional extension filter, e.g. pdf, txt, rust

directory.description: Root path when scope is directory

tools.name: read_file_content
tools.description: Read file text content safely with maximum byte size guard.

tools.name: write_file_content
tools.description: Create or overwrite file with text content.

tools.name: open_file
tools.description: Open file using system default program or specified application.

tools.name: get_file_default_app
tools.description: Get current Windows default application association for a file or extension.

tools.name: set_file_default_app
tools.description: Set default application association for a file extension.

prog_id_or_app_path.description: Application ProgID or absolute executable path

tools.name: search_folders
tools.description: Search specifically for folders/directories across the filesystem.

directory.description: Root path when scope is directory

tools.name: list_folder_contents
tools.description: List immediate files and subfolders inside a directory.

tools.name: create_folder
tools.description: Create a new folder (including parent directories).

tools.name: open_folder
tools.description: Open folder in Windows Explorer or configured file manager.

tools.name: get_folder_default_app
tools.description: Get current Windows default file manager application for opening folders.

tools.name: set_folder_default_app
tools.description: Set default application for opening folders in Windows.

prog_id_or_app_path.description: Target file manager ProgID or executable path

tools.name: list_all_tags
tools.description: List all configured file tags in NanoFile database with item count and color tokens.

tools.name: delete_tag
tools.description: Delete a tag from NanoFile tag library and detach from all items.

tools.name: rename_tag
tools.description: Rename a tag globally across NanoFile database.

tools.name: get_item_tags
tools.description: Get all tags attached to a specific file or folder.

tools.name: set_item_tags
tools.description: Assign tags to a file or folder in NanoFile.

tags.description: List of tag names to attach

tools.name: remove_item_tags
tools.description: Remove specified tags from a file or folder.

tags.description: List of tag names to detach

tools.name: get_item_metadata
tools.description: Read comprehensive metadata. For folders, automatically calculates total recursive size and item count.

tools.name: get_media_metadata
tools.description: Extract specialized media metadata (resolution, duration, bitrate, codec).

tools.name: search_apps
tools.description: Search installed applications registered in Windows Start Menu and Registry.

tools.name: launch_app
tools.description: Launch an application by executable path or registered app name.

app_path.description: Executable path or registered app command

tools.name: uninstall_app
tools.description: Trigger Windows uninstallation workflow for an installed application.

tools.name: get_favorites
tools.description: Get all pinned favorite files, folders, and quick-access locations in NanoFile.

tools.name: add_favorite
tools.description: Pin a file or folder to NanoFile favorites.

tools.name: remove_favorite
tools.description: Unpin an item from NanoFile favorites by path.

tools.name: vault_get_status
tools.description: Query current privacy vault lock state and configuration.

tools.name: vault_unlock
tools.description: Unlock privacy vault with password.

tools.name: vault_lock
tools.description: Instantly lock privacy vault and purge decryption keys from memory.
